6. Creators

Built for Kingdom Creators

Strengthen your craft. Grow your platform. Build sustainable opportunities. Connect with people who can help you move forward.

14–16 April 2027 · Royal Majestic Hotel, Johannesburg
Empowering Voices

The Creator Opportunity

Christian creators are helping shape how faith is communicated, experienced and understood.

Faith Nexus provides a meeting place for creators and the organisations that influence the creator economy. Meet broadcasters, publishers, technology companies, brands, mentors, funders and fellow creators.

Dedicated Spaces

Creator Experiences

01

Nexus Creators Lounge

A dedicated environment for connection, conversation and collaboration.

02

Nexus Studio

A live content and production environment operating from the heart of Faith Nexus.

03

Creator Masterclasses

Practical learning with experienced practitioners across storytelling, production, audience development, technology and creative enterprise.

04

Creators Market

A platform for discovering Christian products, content, platforms and creative businesses.

05

Nexus Pitches

A space for selected creators, founders and innovators to present promising ideas, projects and ventures.

06

Storytellers Showcase

Celebrating compelling stories and creative voices emerging from Africa.

Join the Community

Faith Nexus is building more than an event audience. We want to connect a community of Kingdom creators who can learn from one another, collaborate and access new opportunities.
